author: GamingBolt
description:
Road to Vostok is an FPS survival sim developed by one person, and it is now in early access. For a very economical asking price, players can experience extremely intense enemy encounters while exploring and scavenging across a desolate, isolated version of the real-world rural landscape which contains the Russian-Finnish border. 

After a vague apocalyptic event, it is kill or be killed and survival of the fittest. Whether you are the hunter or the hunted depends on how you choose to move through the game’s unforgiving environment. Keep your eyes peeled and your ears tuned in, because life-or-death situations await around every corner in Road to Vostok.
title: Road To Vostok Early Access Review - The Best Thing Since STALKER

author: GamingBolt
description:
Pragmata can be a daunting enterprise when you first set out to get to the bottom of events at The Cradle as Hugh, Diana in tow. There’s a lot to take in, and fighting off enemies even as you’re busy trying to hack their systems can get a tad overwhelming. 

Well, we’re here to help you get better at fighting off The Cradle’s legions, with a collection of tips aimed at helping you come to grips with the combat while also figuring out optimal loadouts to let you get more confident. 

There’s something for everyone in here, so join us as we take you through a few tips and tricks to make Pragmata a title that you’re going to enjoy, and perhaps even adore once you get a handle.
title: Pragamata - 15 Things I Wish I Knew Before Playing The Game

author: GamingBolt
description:
2019 was a different time in many more ways than one, and for 4A Games, it was when we first heard about the next mainline entry in the Metro series. However, throughout the years, there's been next to nothing else...until now. Metro 2039 has finally emerged, and thanks to an Xbox First Look, there are plenty of new details to scour through.

While based on the novels by Dmitry Glukhovsky, 4A Games touts this as a brand new original story with a new protagonist and cast of characters. Plenty of ties abound to the previous games and universe as a whole, but it's a place for newcomers to jump in and venture into the Metro for the first time. A single-player story experience, hand-crafted from the ground up to enthral and shock you.
title: Metro 2039 - 5 BRAND New Details You May NOT KNOW
